csv_project_name: Engineering Services for I 69 Bridge Replacement
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide Project Development Services District Bridge Project (Replacement), Bridge Replacement Project on Old SR-132 over I-69, .93 miles North of SR-38. The selected firm shall perform preliminary engineering and plan development services necessary to produce construction contract documents in accordance with the INDOT project development process. The selected firm shall complete Bridge Design, Environmental Documentation, and Construction Phase Services. Other services such as Waterway Permits, Ecological Surveys, Archeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigation, professional public outreach and marketing services, and Wetland Mitigation, Small Culverts and Hydraulics Design may be included later if these work types become necessary. INDOT will provide the Geotechnical Engineering, Utility Coordination, Pavement Analysis-Design Services, and Real Estate Services for this project, if needed. The INDOT Project Manager and the Consultant will schedule the Scoping Meeting within two (2) weeks of the Notice of Selection. The selected firm's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for his RFP item. The contract may utilize the INDOT eInvoice application.

title: Engineering Services for I-69 Bridge Replacement
short_description: Design services for replacing the Old SR-132 bridge over I-69 in Indiana.
project_location: Indianapolis, Marion County, Indiana, USA; Old SR-132 over I-69, 0.93 miles north of SR-38.
project_scope: Replacement of the existing bridge carrying Old SR-132 over I-69. The assignment covers project development for a district bridge replacement, including preliminary engineering, plan development, bridge design, environmental documentation, and construction phase services to produce construction contract documents under the INDOT project development process. Potential additional tasks may include waterway permits, ecological surveys, archaeological investigations, historical/architectural investigation, public outreach, wetland mitigation, small culverts, and hydraulics design. Geotechnical engineering, utility coordination, pavement analysis/design, and real estate services are to be provided by INDOT if needed.
services: Project development services; preliminary engineering; plan development; bridge design; environmental documentation; construction phase services; possible optional services including waterway permits, ecological surveys, archaeology, historical/architectural investigation, public outreach, wetland mitigation, culvert and hydraulics design.

- Road bridge over interstate highway suggests meaningful structural and staging complexity.
- Environmental and permitting scope indicates early project involvement.

fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated.
